say.speaker: duskull
say.text: Begone, shadow thieves! You’ll not touch these graves while my flame still burns!

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Lower your lantern, caretaker. We serve King Serperior, and we honor those who rest here.

say.speaker: duskull
say.text: Sir Empoleon’s crest... and a Dragon heir! Forgive me. Gengar’s scouts are raiding this shrine.

say.speaker: advisor
say.text: So the creepy ghost is on our side. Great. Then who’s laughing down in the chasm?

say.speaker: shadowbinder_spiritomb
say.text: Kukuku... Lord Gengar claims every ward on this ridge. Sink into the dark, little sparks.
